home_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished original Japanese website homepage proposal for 大谷民宿, a small seaside inn in 三重県紀北町. EXACT canvas 1536x864 (16:9). Presentation board: large desktop webpage left, legible mobile webpage right, both fully contained with margins. Single improvement: photographs and lodging/food descriptions reflow vertically to mobile width without horizontal overflow, with clear phone inquiry access. White warm paper, deep marine teal, muted sand accents, generous typography. Header 大谷民宿 and small 三重県紀北町. Desktop hero: artistic original photograph of gentle ocean and green distant coastline, generic illustrative landscape, no actual-property depiction. Heading 「海のそばで、ゆっくりと。」. Three concise cards 「宿のご案内」「お料理」「釣りのご案内」. Footer inquiry CTA 「ご宿泊のお問い合わせ」 and 「0597-49-3433」. Mobile mirrors content in vertical cards with large readable wrapped text, clear phone CTA. Do not add form, prices, availability, reviews, awards, facilities or guaranteed services. No invented real building/interior. Visible board label 「非公式デザイン案」 and 「写真はイメージです」. Japanese accurate and not overcrowded. This is a visual concept, no before/after comparison.
inquiry_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference image is the homepage style only. Generate a separate matching contact-information page proposal for 大谷民宿. Exact canvas 1536x864 16:9. Same deep marine teal, warm ivory paper, wave motif, elegant readable Japanese. Large desktop page left and mobile page right. Core improvement: mobile shows content vertically inside viewport, wrapped readable text and large phone button. Page title 「ご宿泊のお問い合わせ」. Main content 「ご宿泊・ご宴会のご相談は、お電話で」. Large correct number 「0597-49-3433」 with phone icon and label 「電話で問い合わせる」. Smaller section 「所在地」 with exact address 「三重県北牟婁郡紀北町道瀬147-2」. A small ocean photograph only, illustrative generic coastline; no maps, invented building/rooms. Small informational note 「ご希望の日程・人数をお伝えください」. Nav 「宿のご案内」「お料理」「アクセス」. Desktop can use two columns, mobile stacks all content vertically with abundant margins, no clipped text. No forms, no online booking, no prices/hours/response promises, no reviews. Visible label 「非公式デザイン案」 and 「写真はイメージです」. Preserve correct company name and phone. Fully contained presentation board.
review: Company name, phone, mobile wrapping, illustrative labels visually verified.
